content.text:
Done. Three PNGs are in the working folder, at exact sizes:

| File | Size | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| `square.png` | 1080×1080 | Logo bar → keynote title → speaker row (circle avatar + name/role) → date/venue + button |
| `landscape.png` | 1920×1080 | Two-column: text left, 470px circle portrait right |
| `story.png` | 1080×1920 | Centered 420px circle portrait, stacked text, full-width pill button |

**Build:** single responsive `card.html` with three `aspect-ratio` media queries, Inter loaded via `@font-face`, background `#0F1226`, violet `#7C5CFF` accents (eyebrow rule, "trust" highlight, portrait ring, button, bottom gradient bar).

**Verification** — I scripted a DOM audit at all three viewports rather than eyeballing:
- **No overflow:** every element's bounding box sits inside the viewport; nothing clipped.
- **No overlap:** pairwise box intersection across header, eyebrow, title, name, role, meta and button returned empty at all three sizes.
- **Circles are true circles:** portrait wrapper/image measured 156×156 / 470×470 / 420×420 — equal width and height, with `object-fit: cover` so the 800×800 photo isn't distorted.
- **Title wraps:** 3 lines (square), 3 (landscape), 4 (story) — no truncation.
- **Font:** `document.fonts.check('700 60px Inter')` returned true, so it's real Inter, not a fallback.

One fix along the way: my first re-render loop silently failed (zsh doesn't word-split unquoted expansions, so `set -- $s` passed the whole string as the viewport arg) and left stale PNGs that I nearly accepted as final — I caught it by measuring the portrait diameter in the image against the CSS and re-ran the commands explicitly.
